programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Bing Wen cuba memberanikan diri untuk beritahu Yuan Ge siapa sebenarnya Jin Nan. Dia teruja apabila Yuan Ge memaklumkan dia telah lama berpisah dengan Jin Nan. Bing Wen tak sabar meminta nasihat daripada sepupunya Hao Shuai.

programme.title: YOUR FINESSE
programme.desc: Fei Ren dan Gong Xin teringat kemenangan besar di kasino lalu menuntut Fu Ling berkongsi wang tersebut. Walau bagaimanapun, situasi menjadi gempar apabila jongkong emas yang disimpan di bilik Fu Ling mendapati telah hilang.

programme.title: MY TWIN LOVER
programme.desc: Encik Zhang menyerahkan bukti yang kukuh mengenai Xian Ming yang telah mengkhianati Syarikat Wei kepada Hou Qin (Hou Ming). Sementara itu, Xian Ming memberitahu Da Feng bahawa Hou Qin (Hou Ming) itu bukan Hou Qin sebenar.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Qian Kun menemui rakaman video yang membuktikan tindakan sabotaj Qian Ying dan Qian Shou di tapak Yong Xing. Mengetahui kebenaran itu, Wan Chao Yuan cuba memperalatkan Meng Zi dan Shi Wei bagi mengugut Qian Kun.

programme.title: FIGHT FOR JUSTICE (1 - 250)
programme.desc: Ivan mengambil keputusan memutus hubungan dengan Chang Sheng kerana tidak sanggup mencederakannya. Dia kemudian bertemu Jia Feng untuk membongkar sumber kewangan baharu Chang Sheng yang diperolehi daripada seorang hartawan misteri.

programme.title: THE QUEEN OF NEWS 2
programme.desc: Kilang ubat Hong King Po meminta ganti rugi dari Open Platform kerana menyiarkan berita palsu. Man mengupah seorang Ketua Pengarah baru untuk Open Platform, dan rakan-rakannya terkejut apabila mendapati individu itu ialah Ying-fei!

programme.title: TAIWAN DEKAT JE
programme.desc: Kenji dan Wang Jing Yi menjelajah Taiwan dari Taipei ke Kaoshiung menggunakan pelbagai pengangkutan awam. Mereka melawat mercu tanda ikonik, menyaksikan kawad tentera, serta meneroka pusat seni sebelum menikmati kulinari.

programme.title: THE GREATEST OF US
programme.desc: Episod ini menampilkan 21 penyanyi tempatan senior dan junior yang bakal menjayakan konsert di Mega Star Arena, Kuala Lumpur. Mereka bersedia menghiburkan penonton menerusi persembahan lebih 30 buah lagu popular.

programme.title: TILL THE END OF THE MOON
programme.desc: Tai Jin memperoleh sepasang gelang Yin dan Yang untuk melindungi Xi Wu, kerana nyawa Xi Wu akan dikaitkan dengan Tai Jin jika mereka berdua sama-sama memakai gelang tersebut. Selagi Tai Jin terselamat, Xi Wu pun tak akan mati.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Pembedahan San Hao berjaya. Wenxue pulang ke rumah selepas keguguran. Wenxue dan ibunya melihat video dikirim oleh orang yang tidak dikenali tentang perbuatan khianat Liu di depan bilik hotel mengakibatkan Wenxue terjatuh.

programme.title: PROUD OF YOU (301-600)
programme.desc: Wenxue menjemput Liu untuk makan tengah hari di mana Wenxue memerhatikan gaya meja Liu menyerupai Kimura Kenji. Wenxue mempersoalkan identiti sebenar Liu dan Liu mengaku dia adalah Zhilong.

programme.title: WOMEN WALK THE LINE
programme.desc: Bing Wen terkejut mendapati sepupunya Hao Shuai bekerja di Shu Mei Corporation. Dia memberikan amaran supaya tidak mendedahkan hubungan mereka kepada sesiapa. Hao Shuai cuba menjodohkan Bing Wen dengan Gu Qiao.

programme.title: THE LEGEND OF TAIWAN 17
programme.desc: Bao Lian menyara hidup dengan menjual kuih-muih, tetapi sering dibuli oleh Shui Xian, anak perempuan Shu Qing yang sombong. Dia berkenalan dengan Kun Cheng dan Liu Liang dan mereka bertiga menjadi adik-beradik angkat.

programme.title: MY ONE AND ONLY
programme.desc: Qiaojuan memutuskan untuk melabur dalam projek kondo Limin. Limin dan Zixiong menasihati Haojian yang tertekan. Ibu Haojian berterima kasih kepada Limin atas membantu Haojian. Keadaan Haojian kekal sama selepas dia melawat pakar psikiatri.

programme.title: ULTIMATE DANCE CREW
programme.desc: Episod ini menyaksikan hos Sean, Vitoria dan Ash memperkenalkan enam kumpulan di "Ultimate Dance Crew". Saingan bermula menerusi cabaran "The Identity" dengan persembahan mereka dinilai oleh pengadil Seven, Danny dan Kid Inn.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Sejak putera menerima azimat harimau, dia terus bimbang tentang keselamatan azimat harimau di istananya. Isterinya mencadangkan menghantar azimat harimau itu kepada adiknya untuk disimpan dan putera bersetuju.

programme.title: LOVE LIKE THE GALAXY
programme.desc: Bu Yi menceritakan tentang pengalaman hidupnya, dan Shao Shang sangat tertekan apabila dia mengetahui masa silam yang tragis antara Bu Yi dan ibunya, Jun Hua. Shao Shang memberitahu ibunya tentang pertunangan Bu Yi.

programme.title: OPM
programme.desc: Harry menghadapi kekurangan dana penyelidikan berkenaan kajian mengesan penyakit keturunan melalui ujian darah. OPM cuba memujuk seorang usahawan kaya Malaysia bernama Lim Xiong untuk membuat pelaburan.

programme.title: THE TREASURED VOICE S7
programme.desc: Episod ini memaparkan 14 orang penyanyi berbakat dari China, Taiwan dan Malaysia dibahagikan kepada 7 pasangan untuk menyertai "The Treasured Voice". Antara mereka adalah Fandy Su, Shaking Chloe, Zhang Bichen, Hou Minghao, Reno Wang.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Yi Shi menolak mentah-mentah pengakuan cinta oleh Dr King. Bok On yang kembali ke Singapura atas permintaan Jin Kok, menumbuk Dr King atas tindakan kejinya yang cuba merosakkan hubungan antara Jin Kok dan Yi Shi.

programme.title: HEALING HEROES
programme.desc: Hao Nan, Ren Hui, Yi Ge dan You Xiao melakukan rawatan kecemasan untuk Ah Sheng, apabila dia tiba-tiba mengalami sesak nafas. Sheng pulih selepas dimasukkan ke hospital. Ren Hui mengakui dia terasa keikhlasan cinta Nan terhadapnya.

programme.title: Celebrating Shuyang Festival in the Longji Rice Terraces
programme.desc: The Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi are renowned for their magnificent scenery and unique cultural value. Julian Waghann from the United States and Eliza Arce from the Philippines arrived at the cloud-wrapped Longji Rice Terraces to take part in the most solemn annual farming festival: the Shuyang Festival. From the moment they stepped onto the terraces, they walked along the narrow ridges, joined the ancient seedling-combing ritual, sampled distinctive local cuisine, and lifted torches at nightfall to parade and pray with the villagers through the shimmering paddies. Through these vivid scenes, they gradually came to understand the centuries-old symbiotic relationship between the local people and the terraces. The Longji Rice Terraces are not just a breathtaking agricultural panorama - they are a mountain lifestyle and a cultural experience that still breathes today.

programme.title: Celebrating Shuyang Festival in the Longji Rice Terraces
programme.desc: The Longji Rice Terraces in Guangxi are renowned for their magnificent scenery and unique cultural value. Julian Waghann from the United States and Eliza Arce from the Philippines arrived at the cloud-wrapped Longji Rice Terraces to take part in the most solemn annual farming festival: the Shuyang Festival. From the moment they stepped onto the terraces, they walked along the narrow ridges, joined the ancient seedling-combing ritual, sampled distinctive local cuisine, and lifted torches at nightfall to parade and pray with the villagers through the shimmering paddies. Through these vivid scenes, they gradually came to understand the centuries-old symbiotic relationship between the local people and the terraces. The Longji Rice Terraces are not just a breathtaking agricultural panorama - they are a mountain lifestyle and a cultural experience that still breathes today.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy. From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

programme.title: Wujiang: The Land of Silk
programme.desc: In this episode, we travel to Wujiang District of Suzhou City on China's east coast to explore the birthplace of silk. There we discover that silk is not merely a precious fabric but also a way of life. For centuries, Wujiang District has been one of China's largest‑scale silk‑producing regions, which has turned it into a major commercial hub. Local residents worship a distinctive deity‑the Silkworm Goddess. Per the traditional Chinese lunar calendar, the Lesser Fullness of Grain (Xiaoman) solar term coincides with the goddess's birthday. Local folk opera troupes take turns staging performances on the stage by the main temple hall over several days to mark the occasion and pray for good fortune. We then learn how silk was manufactured centuries ago, before seeing how imperial‑grade silk is being reinvented for modern‑day fashion.

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. The Corban Festival began here with the arrival of Islam in the 7th century AD, and has developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar, just as important as Spring Festival. Locals load their tables with food to reward themselves for a year of hard work, and celebrate a tradition of sharing and generosity.

programme.title: The secret of the 'Long Hair' village
programme.desc: For the Red Yao women of Guangxi, southern China, hair is far more than a mark of beauty - it's a living narrative of identity, lineage, and nature. Each stage of life is reflected in how they wear it, carrying the memory of their families and the wisdom of their ancestors. Their time-honored rice-water hair care ritual is not just a beauty secret - it's a thread connecting generations, preserving ecological knowledge passed down through centuries. Join CGTN host Julian Waghann and Filipina singer Eliza Arce as they step into Huangluo Yao Village, known as the "World's Longest Hair Village," to uncover the stories and traditions behind the Red Yao's legendary long hair.

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Sam Kim
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer Sam Kim! This artist made himself known to the public in 2013 as the runner-up of the popular talent show K-pop Star Season 3. Then he made his official debut in 2016 and has been mesmerizing listeners with his velvety voice and songwriting skills since then. Thanks to his outstanding musicality he has also worked with a number of A-list musicians including IU Crush Zico and more. In June this year Sam Kim released his new single The Juice after a break of about 2 years. With a blend of retro pop and hip hop this autobiographic song depicts his worn-out state of mind interestingly through groovy dance moves. So he has proved that he can sing compose and even dance making us eagerly anticipate what more he has in store for us. In this episode Sam Kim performs The Juice Make Up Seattle and more to showcase the quintessence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented singer!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung Hwan
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Korea's ballad prince Jung Seung Hwan! Jung Seung Hwan known for his signature suave and captivating voice released his first physical album in two years — an EP titled Five Words Left Unsaid. The album is full of heartrending ballads that show off the artist's prowess including the lead single We From The First. It is about a man who develops romantic feelings for a close friend but is unable to express himself and quietly suffers alone. The album also features a song written by IU Love Letter which is known to be the first song she gave to another artist. The ballad prince is here on I'm LIVE once again to impress everyone with a brand new setlist including We From The First Voice Walking into the forest and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let the artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jeon Jin hee
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer and pianist Jeon Jin hee! This artist burst into the music industry as the leader of the quartet Ravie Nuage. Then she started her career as a solo artist in 2017 with the album Piano and Voice featuring a number of talented vocalists including Nine from Dear Cloud Kwak Jin-eon and Lee Young-hoon. Renowned for her ability to empower vocalists by offering instrumental support when they need it the most she provides empathy with her heartfelt music delivered through varied voices. In January this year Jeon Jin hee released her first instrumental album Breathing featuring 13 tracks she shared on her SoundCloud. Each track is associated with each month of the year letting us enjoy all 12 months in a new creative way. In this episode Jeon Jin hee performs Our Love Was Summer daymoon We Lost Us as well as summernight and rainsummernight from her latest album. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this wonderful artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Sam Kim
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer Sam Kim! This artist made himself known to the public in 2013 as the runner-up of the popular talent show K-pop Star Season 3. Then he made his official debut in 2016 and has been mesmerizing listeners with his velvety voice and songwriting skills since then. Thanks to his outstanding musicality he has also worked with a number of A-list musicians including IU Crush Zico and more. In June this year Sam Kim released his new single The Juice after a break of about 2 years. With a blend of retro pop and hip hop this autobiographic song depicts his worn-out state of mind interestingly through groovy dance moves. So he has proved that he can sing compose and even dance making us eagerly anticipate what more he has in store for us. In this episode Sam Kim performs The Juice Make Up Seattle and more to showcase the quintessence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented singer!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Jung Seung Hwan
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is Korea's ballad prince Jung Seung Hwan! Jung Seung Hwan known for his signature suave and captivating voice released his first physical album in two years — an EP titled Five Words Left Unsaid. The album is full of heartrending ballads that show off the artist's prowess including the lead single We From The First. It is about a man who develops romantic feelings for a close friend but is unable to express himself and quietly suffers alone. The album also features a song written by IU Love Letter which is known to be the first song she gave to another artist. The ballad prince is here on I'm LIVE once again to impress everyone with a brand new setlist including We From The First Voice Walking into the forest and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and let the artist melt your soul!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - JANNABI
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is JANNABI! JANNABI brought a huge retro sensation to Korea's music scene upon their debut in 2014. Since then the band has developed their unique retro vibe in both music and fashion. The band is back with its third full-length album The Land of Fantasy to nourish our souls once again. Through its 13 tracks all written by CHOI JUNG HOON with the help of guitarist KIM DO HYUNG this land of fantasy beautifully captures hope love courage and friendship. Just like their previous releases the new album provides an eclectic yet coherent collection of folk-rock ballads and playful pop-infused melodies but with greater depth and beauty. In this episode JANNABI performs A Ballad of Non Le Jon Confession Show The King of Romance Time I Know Where The Rainbow has Fallen and Bluebird Spread your wings! Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy their new songs live!

programme.title: I'M LIVE - Damons year
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Damons year! This artist started his career as a musician in 2017 with the song Couldn't Sleep. Since then he has mesmerized listeners with his heartwarming melodies and sentiments. Also known for his poetic lyrics like I will hold your hands you can just relax It was like an ice burn Then one light came into my blurry eyes; it reached its hand out and lifted me up he presents music that suits all 365 days and 12 months of the year just like his stage name Damons year (day month year). In this episode he performs Rainbow ai Cherry Your Knight yours and Pattern to showcase the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented musician!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: FRankly is made up of vocalist and guitarist Jung Seung-Hwan, guitarist Na Hyung-chul, drummer Ato, and bassist Koo Dong-uk. Deeply inspired by the 2000s Brit pop and American alternative rock, their music encapsulates authentic retro sentiments. However, they also display their trademark, youthful energy in many other elements of their musical work, such as album covers and song descriptions, making everyone fall for their kaleidoscopic qualities. In this episode, FRankly performs “TR,” “Grow Up!,” “DD (Drunk Dreaming,” “Help me,” and their latest single “Novel.”

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: BAND NAH is comprised of guitarist and vocalist Nah Sang-hyun, drummer Kang Hyun-woong, and bassist PAIIEK. This 88io debuted in 2015 with the EP, “Tingling,” and has released about 90 songs since then. Impressively enough, their music is as diverse as it is prolific. They have been evolving in unpredictable ways every time while maintaining their delightful spirit - no wonder why they are highly sought after for concerts and festivals. In this episode, BAND NAH performs “Shine,” which they released early this year, “Love Love Love,” Spotlight“ featured on the sound88ack of ”Yumi’s Cells,“ ”88,“ and ”1+1“ to showcase the essence of their musicality.

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin! Isaac Hong made himself known to the public with his Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest-winning self-written song “Spring” in 2013. Since then, he has steadily built up his own musical world, marked by his trademark, mellow vocals and delicate sentiments. This time, he collaborated with renowned jazz pianist Sooyoung Chin to drop their project album, “Everland.” It is a mostly English-language album made through months of full collaboration, and the two describe it as “a record of their conversations over piano.” Using the common language of music, the two expanded their reach into each other’s respective universes. In this episode, Isaac Hong X Sooyoung Chin performs their songs “(n)everland,” “a bird,” “pages,” and also Hong’s own pieces “Rain” and “Stay.” Tune in to I’m LIVE and join their beautiful jazzy conversation!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter BOL4! BOL4 is An Ji-Yeong’s one-person band, known for its adorable sounds and lyrics depicting spring, stars, cherry blossoms, and the universe. In April, BOL4 released its new album, “LOVE.zip,” illustrating various forms of love through the language of music. Following the release, An also held a concert and impressed the audience with her unique, silky voice as well as her growth as a musician. BOL4 is making a comeback on I’m LIVE for the first time in 4 years, marking its third appearance, with the first one in 2017 and the second in 2019. In this episode, BOL4 performs “FRIEND THE END, ”ROME,“ ”Red Lipstick,“ ”Stars over me,“ and more to show off her artistry. Tune in to I’m LIVE and enjoy this new extraordinary performance presented by An Ji-Yeong!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is 10CM! 10CM, a.k.a. the idol star of the Korean indie scene, is back on I’m LIVE“ with his new song ”My Ultimate First Love.“ As the title implies, this new song depicts a man’s first love and childhood and apparently is the one-man band’s first song about first love. Full of 10CM’s trademark sentiments, it praises the purity of young love, and to commemorate the release, 10CM also organized a large-scale flash mob challenge together with about 1,000 musicians. 10CM has released numerous chart-topping hits since its debut in 2010. Also known for his fantastic live performances and stage manners, he’s a truly sought-after musician both at home and abroad. 10CM previously mentioned that he wanted to be just 10 cm away from the audience, not 1 meter, when he takes part in I’m LIVE again. Within a distance of 10 cm, he performs “My Ultimate First Love,” “Gradation,” “Phonecert,” “Drawer,” and more to warm our hearts. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet 10CM!

programme.title: I'm LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week’s episode of I’m LIVE is singer-songwriter MRCH! MRCH made herself known to the public through a music show in 2018. After getting a music composition degree at Yonsei University, she released her debut mini-album, “Let’s march!” and has built her career as not only a singer but also a composer and lyricist, co-composing “Talk that Talk,” the lead single of Twice’s 11th mini-album. This musician is also active on YouTube; her cover of Coldplay’s “Viva La Vida” gained 6.5 million views and engraved her name in the minds of music fans around the world. Apparently, I’m LIVE is MRCH’s first TV appearance, and she is bound to showcase all that she has in store. In this episode, MRCH performs “To the dawn,” “Still Romance,” “Love is a magic,” “MRCH mood,” and more. Tune in to I’m LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: Santai 612
programme.desc: Pengisian slot: Nasihatul Tasnim merangkumi perkongsian ilmu Tauhid yang menyentuh aspek keimanan dan kehidupan seharian. Slot ini turut diserikan dengan segmen Muzik Ekspress – Rima yang menampilkan siaran lagu-lagu Irama Melayu pilihan. Seterusnya, BBMU (Bingkisan Buat Mu) membawakan dedikasi khas kepada pendengar, di samping penyampaian ucapan yang diterima melalui Facebook dan WhatsApp. Slot ini juga memuatkan hebahan terkini sebelum diakhiri dengan penutup yang ringkas dan bermakna.

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Greyhound trainer John Thompson calls on Dr. Matt for help to get his lame star runner back on track. Matt removes a thorn from the greyhound's foot, but the pressure's on to get him fit enough for the next big race.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: At an address in the Wirral, Inspector Anthony Joynes finds two collie crosses, Patch and Socks. Both dogs are in very poor condition and Anthony needs to get them out. Inspector Herchy Boal is called to Scooby's rescue. She's collapsed with puncture wounds after fighting with two other dogs. Scooby is in shock so she needs urgent medical care.

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.title: 音乐下午茶Teabreak
programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.desc: S3 , E3 : Jane, Cliff, Rita and Vic are trapped in personal purgatories facing figures from their past. Meanwhile, Dorothy and Larry hire a specialised agency to save them.

programme.title: Outlander
programme.desc: S1 , E12 : Claire Randall, a nurse in World War II, mysteriously goes back in time to Scotland in 1743. There, she crosses paths with a Highland warrior and gets drawn into an epic rebellion.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E1 : Boruto, the son of Seventh Hokage Naruto Uzumaki, saves Denki from bullies. Later, Boruto sees Denki again, but this time the child acts strangely and Boruto notices he has warped chakra.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E2 : After being suspended for the uproar he caused at the entrance ceremony, Boruto makes his way to the academy for the first time.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E3 : After getting caught in a fight between Metal and Shikadai, Boruto notices that Metal's chakra is warped, just like Denki's.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E4 : At Shino Aburame's suggestion, Boruto and his classmates split into gendered teams to capture rooftop flags. When the boys fall behind, Boruto resorts to drastic measures.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E5 : A transfer student from the Hidden Sound Village quickly dazzles his peers with his exceptional skills. However, Boruto harbours deep doubts about the newcomer's true motives.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E6 : When Shino begins displaying highly erratic behaviour, Boruto, Shikadai and Mitsuki fall victim to his sudden ambush. Consequently, they band together to survive their teacher's attack.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E7 : Cho-Cho, feeling watched, uncovers her stalker, Magire Kakuremino. However, he confesses that he was following Sumire due to a crush. Soon after, Cho-Cho urges him to reveal his feelings to her.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E8 : An enigmatic spiritual energy visible exclusively to Boruto spreads rapidly across the Leaf Village. Later, following a strange vision triggered by jutsu, Boruto turns to his grandfather for guidance.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E9 : Boruto's aunt Hanabi offers to spar with him to activate the Byakugan he believes he possesses, but when they try everything and fail, Boruto starts doubting himself.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E10 : Boruto nicknames the mysterious shadow 'The Ghost' and decides to solve the recent Ghost incidents with Shikadai and Mirsuki.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E11 : During a tour of workplaces for their school assignment, Sumire, Wasabi and Namida get hurt because of the Ghost Incident. Thus, Boruto becomes more determined to solve the case.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E12 : When Ghost incidents suddenly cease, Boruto and his classmates wonder what changed. Later, Mitsuki questions his classmates to better understand the changes happening to him.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E13 : Mitsuki exposes details regarding the spectral disturbances, driving Boruto to halt the offender. Meanwhile, Naruto and his council reel at the culprit's identity.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E14 : The mysterious person behind the monster attack aims to settle a grudge with Hidden Leaf Village in memory of Danzo Shimura. But Boruto uses his special sight to follow the monster back to its master.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E15 : In the aftermath of the Ghost Incident, Boruto's mysterious new power disappears. Later on, Boruto and Mitsuki have trouble finding a third student to join their team.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E16 : As exams loom, Boruto and his friends try to help Denki and Iwabe with training and studying. However, their attempts risk making the students' performances even worse.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E17 : When Sarada accidentally leaves a teddy bear intended for a hospitalised child on a train, she goes back to find it. Meanwhile, Cho-Cho joins in the search.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E18 : When Boruto's sister, Himawari, falls ill, Boruto's resentment of his father's focus on duty instead of family comes to the surface.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E19 : Naruto chases Boruto around the village after Boruto pulls a prank, which reminds Sarada of her father, Sasuke. After finding a picture of him with a young woman, Sarada searches for her.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E20 : Sasuke warns Naruto about a Sharingan user, while Sarada, questioning her mother's identity, travels with Cho-Cho to find her father and encounters Sasuke's enemy.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E21 : Sarada arrives at the tower to meet her father, but Sasuke hurts her with his awkward response. Meanwhile, a father-son duo calling themselves Shin Uchiha attacks with their Sharingan.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E22 : Shin captures Sakura beyond Naruto's tracking ability and Sasuke discovers countless Sharingan embedded in Shin's arm. Soon, the group follows clues to Orochimaru's old laboratory.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E23 : Sarada pursues Shin with Sasuke, Naruto and Cho-Cho to rescue Sakura. Subsequently, she observes the bond between Sasuke and Sakura.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E24 : The Five Kage arrive in Hidden Leaf Village for a summit. Meanwhile, Boruto wants to pull a prank despite heightened security and Sarada sets her sights on becoming Hokage.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E25 : Boruto and his classmates visit the Village Hidden in the Mist for a field trip with Kagura Karatachi as guide. However, despite the war's end, dissatisfaction persists among some shinobi.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E26 : Kagura and Chojuro escort Boruto and his classmates on a tour of the Hidden Mist Academy. Subsequently, Chojuro arranges for Boruto to have a sparring match with Kagura.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E27 : Tsurushi Hachiya, Kagura's former classmate, finds Boruto and his friends annoying and kidnaps Denki. Soon, Kagura and Boruto set out to rescue him and battle against Hachiya and his crew.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E28 : Kagura accepts the famed sword Hiramekarei from Chojuro but unknowingly becomes entangled in a scheme by his acquaintance Shizuma Hoshigaki, who opposes the peaceful shinobi order.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E29 : The group calling themselves the New Seven Ninja Swordsmen begin an insurrection. Meanwhile, the current and previous Mizukage want to execute the perpetrators.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E30 : Chojuro leads Boruto and Sarada to Shizuma and his swordsmen. A thick fog separates the trio, forcing Boruto into a direct confrontation with Kagura.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E31 : Boruto Uzumaki follows in his father Naruto's footsteps by training to become a powerful ninja, but being the son of the village's leader comes with its own unique challenges.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E32 : As the group prepares to leave for home, Chojuro, the Mizukage, sees them off. However, Kagura, on the other hand, suddenly goes missing.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E33 : After losing his ability to perform the Super Beast Scroll, a frustrated Inojin seeks advice from Sai. At his father's suggestion, he enters a children's art contest to find his way back.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E34 : Boruto and his classmates go camping to try to catch the mysterious fish, the Eternal Carp. Meanwhile, with graduation coming up, Boruto wants to make the class' last time together memorable.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E35 : Boruto realises his path toward becoming a ninja has been easy. As the students prepare for their finals, Boruto meets Sukea, a journalist who gives Boruto a warning.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E36 : After completing their written exams, Boruto and the others prepare for a practical test where they face Kakashi and other instructors in live combat.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E37 : Kakashi lectures Boruto about his lackluster motivation to become a ninja. Meanwhile, after Boruto's classmates arrive to help him escape, they encourage him to rise above Kakashi's evaluation.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E38 : Boruto and his classmates take their initial steps as genin by forming three-person squads. Meanwhile, Boruto and Sarada appeal to the Hokage to change their team after being paired together.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E39 : Having previously suffered from amnesia, Mitsuki joins his parent, Orochimaru, to reclaim his forgotten past. However, he uncovers a shocking revelation during the journey.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E40 : Team 7 embarks on a new operation to protect a vulnerable community from ruthless outlaws. However, they quickly discover the perilous reality and extreme stakes of their deployment.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E41 : Team 7 tracks down Kiri's kidnappers, but the three young ninja must take down a skilled opponent when they become separated from Konohamaru.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E42 : Team 7's initial assignments go smoothly and Boruto grows restless for a challenge. Later, the team receives new orders when a high-strung man wearing an explosive vest threatens to blow up a bank.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E43 : A notorious criminal faction plunders the city's bank. However, despite the good cause behind their actions, Boruto rejects their criminal exploits and pledges to arrest them.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E44 : As a crime wave hits the Hidden Leaf Village, the academy deploys additional ninjas to neutralise the threat. Meanwhile, Shikadai strikes up an unexpected friendship with Ryugi.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E45 : Discontent continues to grow inside Hidden Leaf because of the Byakuya Gang's influence. Elsewhere, Ryogi, haunted by his past, casts his friendship with Shikadai into doubt and stops meeting him.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E46 : The ninja disperse throughout the village to scrutinize the escalating demonstrations against the Kaminarimon Company. However, Shikadai uncovers the Byakuya Gang's covert strategy and promptly detaches from his squad.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E47 : After attacking Katasuke's research centre, the Byakuya Gang escapes by train. While Boruto goes after the leader, Shikadai fights his former friend, Ryogi, hoping he can still get through to him.

programme.title: Boruto: Naruto Next Generations
programme.desc: S1 , E48 : Team 5 receives orders to participate in a documentary promoting the ninja academy. Meanwhile, Udon has doubts about the idea, and his pupils feel pressured to prove themselves after being suspended.

programme.title: They Wait in the Dark
programme.desc: Amy and her adopted son Adrian flee from her abusive ex-girlfriend Judith. Seeking refuge in an abandoned farmhouse in Amy's Kansas hometown, they confront a supernatural evil force from her dark past that haunts Adrian. As Judith pursues them, Amy and Adrian must face the dangers both outside and within the house.

programme.title: 3AM
programme.desc: The Hungry Ghost Festival is around the corner. A newcomer at a workplace offends the ghosts in his office building when he shows disrespect for the spirits on his first day at work. In the course of a night shift, the man and his colleagues working overtime experience spooky encounters that make them reflect on their behaviours and beliefs...

programme.title: Apartment 212
programme.desc: Escaping an abusive past, Jennifer moves into Apartment 212 for a fresh start, only to wake each day with painful bite marks. She soon discovers an ancient parasite that feeds on human flesh lurking within the walls. As attacks intensify, she must confront a nightmare more terrifying than her past before it consumes her.

programme.title: Sinister
programme.desc: Jia Hao and his friends gather to celebrate his birthday at a villa. However, the festivities take a dark turn when they connect to a deadly VR game in which they must light candles and dodge ghosts to survive. Tragedy strikes as two of his friends fall victim to the escalating horrors within, plunging them all deeper into a chilling nightmare.

programme.title: Waning Moon
programme.desc: Nuanchan is a famous and highly respected spiritual medium in a rural village in Thailand. She wants to train her niece, Ploy, to succeed her and Ploy needs to remain a virgin. When Ploy falls in love with her childhood friend Tul, their lives are in danger as the secret of the spiritual world is being unveiled.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.
